verdict.rationale: Netlify's own docs say it offers managed Postgres through Netlify Database and 'instant databases', so the core of provisioning a managed Postgres database is first-party. Nothing in the pack covers point-in-time recovery, replicas, or high availability. Third-party integrations such as Turso and Supabase are not credited. Missing for 10: point-in-time recovery, read replicas, high availability/failover, in-depth database docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can provision a fully-managed Postgres database with point-in-time recovery, replicas, and high availability
